summary: Branch adds scripts/ensure-deps.js (58 lines) and three npm lifecycle hooks (prebuild/prelint/pretest) to auto-install missing dependencies before verification gates. It was a verification-error fix for parent task bd1023af (ARCHITECTURE.md drift docs), which was itself found superseded in a prior investigation (merged 2026-07-20 as PR #9631d833 on main). The branch commit is from 2026-05-03; its package.json diff reveals the test script still references the old integrations/test-e2e-flow.js runner, not the current scripts/test-suite-gate.js — confirming the branch is 2.5 months stale and based on a superseded codebase state. The dep-install problem it solved has since been addressed via separate fixes (PR #828, #817, #1937: Playwright/Chromium auto-install). No PR was ever created for this branch.
